llm_synthesis.task: Groq llama-3.1-8b-instant (T=0, 3-shot) synthesizes classifier + retriever + resolution signals into a Pydantic-validated TriagePlan (component, similar issues, resolution summary/interval/bucket, priority, next steps, summary).
llm_synthesis.product_use_case: A triage engineer reads this to decide routing and urgency in seconds. Priority of needs: (1) claims are NOT fabricated -- a cited similar-issue or component that doesn't trace to what upstream models actually produced actively misleads a human who trusts the tool; (2) actionable next steps; (3) directionally correct priority/resolution framing. Fabrication is qualitatively worse than a soft miss and should not be interchangeable in the quality metric.
